name: BluePrint
description: Read, create, and safely edit BluePrint Xianji notes through PAT-authenticated MCP.

descriptions.en: Read, create, and safely edit BluePrint Xianji notes through PAT-authenticated MCP.
descriptions.zh-CN: 通过 PAT 鉴权 MCP 查看、新建并安全编辑 BluePrint 随手记。

author: mcx

preferences.label: MCP endpoint
preferences.description: BluePrint Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. A base URL is normalized to /mcp.

descriptions.en: BluePrint Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. A base URL is normalized to /mcp.
descriptions.zh-CN: BluePrint Streamable HTTP MCP 地址；基础地址会自动补全 /mcp。

preferences.label: Personal access token
preferences.description: BluePrint PAT with content:read and content:write. The token is sent only as an Authorization header.

descriptions.en: BluePrint PAT with content:read and content:write. It is never placed in content, URLs, caches, or logs.
descriptions.zh-CN: 需要 content:read 与 content:write；令牌不会写入内容、URL、缓存或日志。

descriptions.en: Choose the host-owned cards or list presentation.
descriptions.zh-CN: 选择宿主提供的卡片或列表布局。

descriptions.en: Adjust spacing without changing the source order.
descriptions.zh-CN: 调整卡片间距，不改变随手记原始顺序。

descriptions.en: Show attached images in the host-owned browsing surface.
descriptions.zh-CN: 在宿主提供的浏览界面中显示附件图片。

preferenceGroups.title: Connection
preferenceGroups.description: Configure and verify the BluePrint MCP connection.

descriptions.en: Configure and verify the BluePrint MCP connection.
descriptions.zh-CN: 配置并验证 BluePrint MCP 连接。

preferenceGroups.title: Browsing
preferenceGroups.description: Choose the note collection layout and media visibility.

descriptions.en: Choose the note collection layout and media visibility.
descriptions.zh-CN: 选择随手记集合布局与媒体显示方式。

commands.name: check-blueprint-connection
commands.title: Check BluePrint Connection
commands.description: Verify the configured endpoint, PAT identity, and available note capabilities.

descriptions.en: Verify the configured endpoint, PAT identity, and available note capabilities.
descriptions.zh-CN: 验证已配置的 MCP 地址、PAT 身份和可用随手记能力。
